newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fresh broker upgrades for Air Liquide.
newsitem.headline: Fresh broker upgrades for Air Liquide.

text.p: Air Liquide was supported on Wednesday by a new upgrade by brokerage Dupont-Denant which changed its recommendation to "market performer" from "sell", fund managers said.
The broker also uncreased its profit forecast for the industrial gases group to 2.61 billion francs in 1996, from 2.26 billion, and the 1997 figure to 2.82 billion from 2.665 billion.
SGE Delahaye had changed its recommendation to "neutral" from "underperformer" on November 20.
Air Liquide was down 0.13 percent at 785 franc at 1138 GMT while the blue-chip index was down 0.44 percent.
